question: Motion to Invoke Cloture: Collins Amdt. No. 6732 to H.R. 6500 — In the nature of a substitute.
result: Cloture Motion Agreed to (91-6, 3/5 majority required)
plain_language: This vote would end debate on a substitute that replaces H.R. 6500's Africa-trade text with a stopgap funding the government into fiscal year 2027 and extending several programs. A Yea limits debate on that substitute. A Nay keeps debate open.
